answer: Proof of stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital, turning an ivory tower of theoretical identity into a verifiable economic commitment. Before the dawn of each epoch, validators must stake assets; the cost for an attacker is the umber weight of the required collateral, which renders the creation of multiple fake identities prohibitively expensive as it forces the attacker to disperse their finite resources, thereby diluting their influence across the network.
